Locker-room print sheet

Use your browser's Print (Cmd/Ctrl+P) on this page for a stripped-down, high-contrast one-pager of all 15 "3 keys" lists - no photos, no quiz, sized for a locker-room wall or a laminated card in a warm-up bag. Everything else on this page hides automatically in print.

How this hub is built & what still needs a human
\1
  • Roster group, archetypes, shooter designations, coverage calls, scout notes, matchups, Game Situations, Team Recall, Keys to Victory and the Actions & Sets call sheet are copied from the coaching staff's two completed G8 ILL 2 data-collection templates (read 21 Oct 2026).
  • Jersey numbers, positions and heights are as given in the Personnel template.
  • C&S and Off Dribble 3P% come from the club's Opponent Shooting #s sheet (Illawarra tab). 3PA Rate, FT%, FT Rate, ORB% and AST% come from RealGM, 2023-24 to 2026-27, all competitions (Summer League and preseason excluded), weighted by games played.
  • Froling's Off Dribble 3P% rests on only 5 attempts and Grida's on 7 (from the club sheet). Narkle's shooting splits use the sheet's 2-year aggregate.
